settings.ourFreeModel.meta.title: Our Free Model
settings.ourFreeModel.meta.description: Free no-key models inside DeepSeek Harness: a roster that follows upstream, live regional availability, genuinely enforced thinking levels, a token dashboard and an OpenAI-compatible local forward port.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.pitch: All you do is install this plugin in dsh — no login, no sign-up, no API key, no other step of any kind. The frontier models are simply there, Muse Spark 1.3 and MiMo V2.6 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
settings.ourFreeModel.title: Our Free Model
settings.ourFreeModel.subtitle: No-key free lane · live availability
settings.ourFreeModel.hint.region: This model is gated by egress country. Once a proxy changes your egress, the next probe moves it into the available group by itself.
settings.ourFreeModel.hint.unknown: Not probed yet, so it stays reachable.
settings.ourFreeModel.hint.hidden: The gateway names it but refuses to route it, so it is out of the model picker. It returns by itself as soon as a probe gets through.
settings.ourFreeModel.hint.sharedBudget: Thinking cannot be switched off on this model, so thinking and the visible answer share one ceiling — a lower rung leaves the answer less room.
settings.ourFreeModel.tag.rungTitle: What each rung actually sends: {ladder}. A rung is one ceiling shared by thinking and the answer, and it never exceeds the max output above or the per-call ceiling in settings.
settings.ourFreeModel.section.modelsHint: Names and capacities come from the upstream roster and published capability tables; availability is measured from this machine.
settings.ourFreeModel.section.dashHint: Written to this machine only; nothing is uploaded.
settings.ourFreeModel.section.forwardHint: Let other local tools reach these models through one base URL.
settings.ourFreeModel.section.prefsHint: Changes take full effect on the next load.
settings.ourFreeModel.heat.title: Token heatmap
settings.ourFreeModel.heat.empty: No usage yet. Have one conversation and come back.
settings.ourFreeModel.curve.title: Cumulative tokens
settings.ourFreeModel.speed.title: Speed
settings.ourFreeModel.speed.note: Output speed covers the {n}/{total} calls it could measure: tokens never streamed out are left out of the numerator, and windows too short to time are dropped.
settings.ourFreeModel.forward.rotateWarn: Regenerating invalidates the old key for every tool using it.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.p1: No credentials: install and use it — no sign-up, no API key to paste.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.p2: The roster follows upstream: models, context lengths and capabilities are re-fetched on every refresh.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.p3: Honest capability claims: anything a probe cannot confirm stays hidden, and each effort level is a real output budget.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s1: Pick any model under the “Our Free Model” group in the composer’s model selector.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s2: For harder reasoning, open the Effort menu — it sends a real budget, not a prompt hint.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s3: To serve other local tools: Settings → Local forward → enable, then copy the base URL and key.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.s4: Region-limited models reclassify themselves once your network egress changes.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f1: Model roster: availability, context length, vision, tunable thinking.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f2: Token heatmap and cumulative curve, per total or per model.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f3: Per-call samples of output speed (tok/s) and time to first token.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f4: OpenAI-compatible forward port with a generated API key.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.f5: Everything stays on this machine — no telemetry.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u1: Announcement center: pushes from the repository owner arrive live, with rich (HTML) layout.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u2: OS notifications: once enabled, new announcements and plugin updates raise system-level toasts.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u3: In-app upgrades: install new releases straight from the settings page, no reinstall needed.
settings.ourFreeModel.ann.u4: Hot reload: upgrades and code changes take effect immediately, without restarting the app.
